messages:
Nina R.: Heads up — BeaconHealth (CUST-9742) dispute: they say we charged promo and full usage on the same invoice for Apr. Invoice INV-2026-0405 shows a $500 promo line AND full usage $500 line for the same resource. They want a correction + statement of account. Ticket attached: https://support.redwood/t/9876.
Omar (Revenue Ops): Thanks. Can you paste the invoice lines? Also need to know if credit should be promo reversal or manual adjustment.
Sophie (Billing): Paste from invoice:
```
Line 1: Promo Credit - APR2026_PROMO (applied) - $500
Line 2: Usage - api.requests - 50,000 tokens - $500
```
Seems like promo was applied and also billed. I'd prefer a manual adjustment credit memo to keep audit traceability. Use GL 6302. Will this be account credit or refund?
Elena T.: Customer requested account credit to apply to next invoice. Fine by us. Approving $500 manual adjustment. Please include memo: "Promo double-applied — INV-2026-0405". @Omar do we also want to adjust promo config to prevent stacking?
Omar (Revenue Ops): Approved. We'll flag promo for rule review. Action items: 1) Sophie to post CM-2026-1130 for -$500; 2) Nina to send customer-facing note; 3) Revenue Ops to update promo rule to prevent stacking. Assigning ENG ticket if needed.
finance-bot: Created billing task BT-2026-334 for CM posting.
Sophie (Billing): Posted CM-2026-1130, GL 6302, memo added. Customer balance updated. Audit ref: https://audit.redwood/cm/CM-2026-1130.
Nina R.: Sent customer note: "We've applied a $500 credit to your account for duplicate promo application on INV-2026-0405. The credit will appear on your next invoice. Thanks for flagging this." Customer replied :thumbsup:.
Omar (Revenue Ops): Promo rule adjusted to block stacking for APR2026_PROMO-type offers. Created ENG-5172 to add an automatic validation in promo service.
Sophie (Billing): Closing BT-2026-334. All set from billing side.
Nina R.: Marking resolved. Thanks team!
